---
title: "`r params$species`"
params:
  species: null
  output_dir: null
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

sp <- params$species
csv_dir <- file.path(params$output_dir, "csv")

# This page is rendered from `species/`, the shared helpers sit one level up.
source(file.path("..", "_common.R")) # nolint: undesirable_function_linter.

species_stats <- read_csv_safe(file.path(csv_dir, "species_stats.csv"))
min_obs <- read_min_obs(csv_dir)
percentage <- read_percentage(csv_dir)
rrmse_comparison <- read_csv_safe(
  file.path(csv_dir, "species_rrmse_comparison.csv")
)
failed_usms <- read_csv_safe(file.path(csv_dir, "failed_usms.csv"))
deteriorated_usm <- read_csv_safe(file.path(csv_dir, "Deteriorated_USM.csv"))
usm_thresholds <- read_csv_safe(file.path(csv_dir, "usm_thresholds.csv"))
rrmse_per_usm <- read_csv_safe(file.path(csv_dir, "rRMSE_per_usm.csv"))

sp_comp <- if (!is.null(rrmse_comparison)) {
  rrmse_comparison[rrmse_comparison$species == sp, , drop = FALSE]
}
sp_failed_usms <- if (!is.null(failed_usms)) {
  failed_usms$situation[failed_usms$species == sp]
}
sp_deteriorated <- if (!is.null(deteriorated_usm)) {
  deteriorated_usm[deteriorated_usm$species == sp, , drop = FALSE]
}

# Data of the scatter plots of this species (one per degraded variable),
# saved by `evaluate()`. Variables are ordered from most to least degraded
# using `sp_comp`'s rRMSE ratio (falls back to the saved order if that data
# isn't available).
scatter_rds <- file.path(
  params$output_dir, "data", paste0(sp, "_degraded_vars.rds")
)
scatter_data <- if (file.exists(scatter_rds)) readRDS(scatter_rds)
scatter_vars <- as.character(scatter_data$vars)

ratio <- rep(NA_real_, length(scatter_vars))
has_ratio <- !is.null(sp_comp) && "rrmse_ratio" %in% names(sp_comp)
if (has_ratio) {
  ratio <- sp_comp$rrmse_ratio[match(scatter_vars, sp_comp$variable)]
}
ord <- order(-ifelse(is.na(ratio), -Inf, ratio))
scatter_vars <- scatter_vars[ord]
scatter_ratio <- ratio[ord]

# Only the variables with a scatter plot (the degraded ones) get a link.
scatter_href <- function(vars) {
  ifelse(vars %in% scatter_vars, paste0("#", scatter_id(vars)), NA_character_)
}
```

```{=html}
<script src="../scatter.js"></script>
```

#| echo: false

if (isTRUE(nrow(sp_comp) > 0)) {
  status_summary(sp_comp, min_obs, href = scatter_href)
} else {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\nNo comparison done.\n:::\n\n")
}

```{r}

dt(species_stats[species_stats$species == sp, , drop = FALSE])
```

### Comparison plot
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
#| out-width: 100%
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(nrow(sp_comp) > 0)
SticsREval::plot_rrmse_comparison(sp_comp, percentage)
```

::: {.callout-note}
A variable is only tested if it has at least `r min_obs` observations
(`n_obs` ≥ `r min_obs`) over the whole species. Variables with fewer
observations are shown in grey (Not tested) above, get no scatter plot
below, and are not tested on the USMs of this species either.
:::


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| eval: !expr length(scatter_vars) > 0
button <- '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" onclick="toggleScatters(%s)">%s</button>' # nolint: line_length_linter
writeLines(c(
  "### Scatter plots",
  "",
  '<div class="scatter-toggle">',
  sprintf(button, c("true", "false"), c("Expand all", "Collapse all")),
  "</div>",
  ""
))
```

```{r}
#| label: scatter-plots
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: !expr length(scatter_vars) > 0
# `scatter_data` holds CroPlotR simulations: its namespace must be loaded for
# `plot()` to dispatch to CroPlotR's method.
invisible(loadNamespace("CroPlotR"))
plots <- plot(
  "New version" = scatter_data$sim,
  "Ref version" = scatter_data$ref_sim,
  obs = scatter_data$obs,
  type = "scatter",
  select_scat = "sim",
  var = scatter_vars
)

# One collapsible block per variable, critical ones open by default.
scatter_status <- rep(NA_character_, length(scatter_vars))
if (!is.null(sp_comp)) {
  scatter_status <- sp_comp$status[match(scatter_vars, sp_comp$variable)]
}

scatter_blocks <- lapply(seq_along(scatter_vars), function(i) {
  variable <- scatter_vars[i]
  status <- scatter_status[i]
  badge <- if (status %in% names(tag_class)) {
    tag_list(variable, status)
  } else {
    sprintf("<strong>%s</strong>", variable)
  }
  ratio <- if (is.na(scatter_ratio[i])) {
    ""
  } else {
    sprintf(
      '<span class="scatter-ratio">rRMSE ratio: %+.2f%%</span>',
      scatter_ratio[i]
    )
  }
  widget <- plotly::ggplotly(
    CroPlotR::extract_plot(plots, var = variable)[[1]],
    height = 450
  )

  htmltools::tags$details(
    class = "scatter",
    id = scatter_id(variable),
    open = if (identical(status, "Critical")) NA,
    htmltools::tags$summary(htmltools::HTML(paste(badge, ratio))),
    widget
  )
})
htmltools::tagList(scatter_blocks)
```
